title: Ten Days that Shook the World
description: Introduces the field of history through the exploration of ten turning points in world history. Each week a guest lecturer focuses on a world-changing moment and then seminars examine the arguments and evidence. Introduces the discipline of History, a range of historical concepts and skills and many of the History Department faculty.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of HSTR 101A, HIST 101 (if taken as section A01 in 201109 or 201309, or as section A02 in 201301), HIST 198 (if taken as section A01 in 201009).
